Weekly Recap: Q2 revenue, profit rise and memory inventory under 10 days Less than 1 min read

005930 Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd (KRX:005930) rode AI-driven memory demand to stronger Q2 revenue and profits as inventory fell under 10 days, tightening short-term supply and prices, while talks on India 5G/PPDR deals and forecasts point to even stronger memory performance by 2027. Previous Week Recap Samsung Electronics Co Ltd Sponsored GDR Pfd Strong Q2 Revenue, Profit : Samsung Electronics (005930) posted strong Q2: consolidated revenue and operating profit rose, led by semiconductor segment strength from AI-memory demand, tight supply and higher prices. GuruFocus Memory Inventory Drops, AI Demand Tightens Supply : Samsung Electronics (005930) memory inventory dropped below 10 days, tightening near-term supply. Strong AI demand for HBM4 and high-end memory boosts pressure on availability and short-term pricing. Invezz Samsung Electronics In Talks With India For PPDR Network : Samsung Electronics (005930) is in talks with India to supply devices and 5G/broadband tech for a planned public protection and disaster relief (PPDR) communications network. Mint UOB Taiwan Sees Stronger 2027 For Samsung Electronics : UOB Asset Management’s Taiwan arm says Samsung Electronics (005930) storage memory maker likely to show stronger performance in 2027 than 2026, citing typical two-year facility build cycles.
